```{r}

# Libraries
library("dada2")

```



```{r}
# Read the names in the fastq files
#path1 <- "C:/Users/snoell/OneDrive - The University of Waikato/Documents/Backup_seqs/Fissure8_amplicons/universal"

path1 <- "C:/Users/steno/Downloads/universal/universal/"

fn_f <- sort(list.files(path = path1 , pattern="_1_cutadapt.fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE))

fn_r <- sort(list.files(path = path1 , pattern="_2_cutadapt.fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE))

# Give the sample names
sample.names <- sort(list.files(path = path1 , pattern="_1_cutadapt.fastq.gz", full.names = FALSE)) %>%
  str_remove_all("_L001_1_cutadapt.fastq.gz")

read.names_f <- sort(list.files(path = path1, pattern="_1_cutadapt.fastq.gz", full.names = FALSE)) %>%
  str_remove_all(".fastq.gz")

read.names_r <- sort(list.files(path = path1 , pattern="_2_cutadapt.fastq.gz", full.names = FALSE)) %>%
  str_remove_all(".fastq.gz")

```

```{r}
# Check quality score of reads ----
#plotQualityProfile(fn_f[3])

# Set up the primer sequences 
# where to check primer sequences - https://www.earthmicrobiome.org/protocols-and-standards/16s/

FWD <- "GTGYCAGCMGCCGCGGTAA"   ## 515F (Parada) 
REV <- "CCGYCAATTYMTTTRAGTTT"  ## 926R (Quince)  


# Write a function that creates a list of all orientations of the primers
allOrients <- function(primer) {
  dna <- DNAString(primer)  
  orients <- c(Forward = dna, Complement = Biostrings::complement(dna), Reverse = reverse(dna), 
               RevComp = reverseComplement(dna))
  return(sapply(orients, toString))  # Convert back to character vector
}

# Primer orientations - forward / complement / reverse / reverse complement
FWD.orients <- allOrients(FWD)
REV.orients <- allOrients(REV)


# Write a function that counts how many time primers appear in a sequence
primerHits <- function(primer, fns) {
  nhits <- vcountPattern(primer, sread(readFastq(fns)), fixed = FALSE)
  return(sum(nhits > 0))
}

# See if sequences have primer - in this example sample #1, change to check others
rbind(FWD.ForwardReads = sapply(FWD.orients, primerHits, fns = fn_f[[2]]), 
      REV.ForwardReads = sapply(REV.orients, primerHits, fns = fn_r[[2]]))


# Create a directory for the filtered files
filt_f <- file.path(path1, "cutadapt.dada2", paste0(read.names_f, "_filt.fastq.gz"))
filt_r <- file.path(path1, "cutadapt.dada2", paste0(read.names_r, "_filt.fastq.gz"))

out <- filterAndTrim(fn_f, filt_f, rev = fn_r, filt.rev = filt_r, 
                      rm.phix = TRUE, compress=TRUE, multithread=TRUE)
out

path2 <- paste0(path1, "/cutadapt.dada2")

# Read the names in the cutadapt trimmed fastq.gz files
fn.filt <- sort(list.files(path2, pattern=".fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE))

#plotQualityProfile(fn.filt[3])

```

```{r}
# Learn the errors ----

# Learn the error Rates
err_f <- learnErrors(filt_f, multithread=TRUE)
err_r <- learnErrors(filt_r, multithread=TRUE)

# visualize the estimated error rates:
plotErrors(err_f, nominalQ=TRUE)

```


```{r}
# Sample Inference ----

# dada command to get the seqeunces
dadaf <- dada(filt_f, err_f, multithread=TRUE)
dadar <- dada(filt_r, err_r, multithread=TRUE)

mergers <- mergePairs(dadaf, filt_f, dadar, filt_r, verbose=TRUE)

# Construct sequence table
seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(mergers)

dim(seqtab)

# The sequence table is a matrix with rows corresponding to (and named by) the samples
# and columns corresponding to (and named by) the sequence variants

# Inspect distribution of sequence lengths
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab)))

#remove some too small or too big ones
seqtab2 <- seqtab[,nchar(colnames(seqtab)) %in% 271:282]
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab2)))

```


```{r}

# Track reads through the pipeline - look at the number of reads that made it through each step in the pipeline

getN <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))

track <- cbind(out, sapply(dadaf, getN), rowSums(seqtab2))
colnames(track) <- c("reads.in", "filter.and.trim", "sample.inference", "right.length")
rownames(track) <- sample.names
track2 <- as.data.frame(track) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop = right.length / reads.in)

track2

# outside of filtering there should be no step in which a majority of reads are lost
# have at least thousands of sequences per-sample, to have good resolution down to 1% frequency - https://github.com/benjjneb/dada2/issues/232
# keep a good proportion of the reads (i.e. >>10%) all the way through the pipeline

# Save the seqtab object
saveRDS(seqtab2, "seqtab.uni")

# Save tracking table
write.csv(track2, "track_uni.csv")

```


```{r}

# Remove chimeras - Chimeric sequences are identified if they can be exactly reconstructed by combining a left-segment and a right-segment from two more abundant parent sequences
seqtab.nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab2, method="consensus", multithread=TRUE, verbose=TRUE)

dim(seqtab.nochim)

sum(seqtab.nochim)/sum(seqtab2)
# [1] 0.98 - the frequency of non-chimeric sequences

saveRDS(seqtab.nochim, "seqtab.nochim.univ")
```

```{r}
# Create a fasta table
name.seq <- paste0("ASV", seq(ncol(seqtab.nochim)))
uniqueSeqs <- as.list(colnames(seqtab.nochim))
write.fasta(uniqueSeqs, name.seq, "asvs_no-filt_univ.fasta")
```



```{R}
# Assign taxonomy ---- using DADA2 bayesian classifier
# DADA2 provides a native implementation of the naive Bayesian classifier method for this
# Maintains formatted training fastas - https://benjjneb.github.io/dada2/training.html

# Silva database; using v. 138.2
#taxa.silva <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochim, "C:/Users/snoell/OneDrive - The University of Waikato/Documents/silva_nr99_v138.2_toGenus_trainset.fa.gz", multithread=TRUE)

taxa.silva <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochim, "C:/Users/steno/Downloads/silva_nr99_v138.2_toGenus_trainset.fa.gz", multithread=TRUE)

# Save the taxanomy table
saveRDS(taxa.silva, "taxa.silva.univ")

```


```{r}
# Handoff to phyloseq ----
# Load all data

#seqtab.nochim <- readRDS("seqtab.nochim.univ")
envdata <-  read.csv("sample_data.csv", row.names = 1, header = TRUE)
#taxa.silva <- as.matrix(readRDS("taxa.silva.univ"))


# Change the row names of the ASV table to match the environmental table 
current <- rownames(seqtab.nochim)
#write.csv(current, "sample_name_map0.csv")

map_df <- as.data.frame(read.csv("sample_name_map2.csv"))
rownames(seqtab.nochim) <- map_df$new[match(rownames(seqtab.nochim), map_df$old)]

#Final phyloseq creation
physeq0 <- phyloseq(otu_table(seqtab.nochim, taxa_are_rows=FALSE), 
                    tax_table(taxa.silva),
                    sample_data(envdata))

#remove low abundance taxa
taxa_sums_total <- taxa_sums(physeq0)

physeq <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums_total > 1, physeq0)

ntaxa(physeq0)
ntaxa(physeq)

#add DNA sequences to phyloseq object
dna <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(taxa_names(physeq))
names(dna) <- taxa_names(physeq)
physeq <- merge_phyloseq(physeq, dna)

#new names for ASVs
new.names <- paste0("ASV_", seq(ntaxa(physeq))) # define new names ASV_1, ASV_2, ...
seqs <- taxa_names(physeq) # store sequences
names(seqs) <- new.names # make map from ASV to full sequence
taxa_names(physeq) <- new.names # rename 
```


```{r}
#remove known erroneous assignments
physeq.fin <- subset_taxa (physeq, (Kingdom !="Eukaryota")) # we remove Eukaryota and NA
physeq.fin <- subset_taxa (physeq.fin, is.na(Order) | Order !="Chloroplast") # we remove Chloroplast
physeq.fin <- subset_taxa (physeq.fin, is.na(Family) | Family != "Mitochondria") 
physeq.fin <- subset_taxa(physeq.fin, !is.na(Phylum))

ntaxa(physeq)
ntaxa(physeq.fin)
#saveRDS(physeq.fin, "physeq.univ")

#saving table
otu_table <- data.frame(otu_table(physeq.fin)) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Sample")

otu_long <- data.table::transpose(setDT(otu_table), make.names = 'Sample', 
                                  keep.names = 'Sample') %>%
  as.data.frame(.) %>%
  dplyr::rename(OTU = 1)

#taxonomy
tax_table <- data.frame(tax_table(physeq.fin)) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "OTU")

#sequence
seq <- physeq.fin@refseq

seq2 <- data.frame(
  OTU = names(seq),
  sequence = as.character(seq)
)

# Join long OTU table to taxonomy
full_df <- tax_table %>%
  left_join(otu_long, by = "OTU") %>%
  left_join(., seq2, by = "OTU")

#write.csv(full_df, "asv_info_univ.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
